Hotel.title: Hotel
Hotel.description: Configuration, locations, and profile for a hotel property.

id.description: Unique hotel identifier matching owner UID or sandbox ID.

persona.description: Concierge AI persona and custom prompt instructions.

faqs.description: Frequently asked questions for the hotel.

slas.description: Service level agreement response targets in minutes.

locations.description: Configured rooms and physical QR locations for the property.

emergencyPhone.description: Front desk or property emergency contact phone number.

Session.title: Session
Session.description: A guest messaging conversation session for a hotel.

guestUid.description: Anonymous or authenticated Firebase UID of the guest.

roomNumber.description: Optional guest room number or short location code.

locationId.description: Opaque configured location identifier from QR or selector.

locationLabel.description: Human-readable location label such as Room 412 or Pool Deck.

locationType.description: Location category type (room, suite, lobby, pool, restaurant, etc.).

lastUpdatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last activity in the session.

previewText.description: Short preview of the latest message.

previewStaffText.description: English preview of the latest message for staff inbox.

isUnread.description: Whether staff has unread guest activity.

status.description: Current conversation state including human takeover.

guestLanguage.description: Optional ISO language code for the guest.

assignedStaffUid.description: UID of the staff associate managing the conversation.

assignedStaffEmail.description: Email of the assigned staff associate.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Individual message within a guest chat session.

text.description: Original message body as authored by sender.

staffText.description: English translation of message for hotel staff.

guestText.description: Translated message in the guest's native language.

originalLanguage.description: ISO 639-1 code of the original message language.

translatedToLanguage.description: ISO 639-1 code of the target translated language.

timestamp.description: Server timestamp when message was sent.

guestUid.description: Guest UID associated with the session.

staffUid.description: Optional staff UID if sent by an associate.

ServiceRequest.title: ServiceRequest
ServiceRequest.description: Guest service request ticket created from chat or structured workflows.

referenceCode.description: Human-friendly tracking reference such as R-4821.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when ticket was created.

lastUpdated.description: Server timestamp when ticket was last updated.

acknowledgedAt.description: Server timestamp when staff acknowledged the request.

completedAt.description: Server timestamp when staff completed the request.

guestUid.description: Firebase UID of the guest who initiated the request.

/hotels/{hotelId}.description: Hotel configuration, locations, and concierge settings.

/hotels/{hotelId}/sessions/{sessionId}.description: Guest messaging sessions belonging to a hotel.

/hotels/{hotelId}/sessions/{sessionId}/m.description: Chat messages within a specific guest session.

/hotels/{hotelId}/requests/{requestId}.description: Service requests generated for hotel staff.
